verdict.rationale: Docs confirm nexus monitoring to identify where registration is needed and state 'you can also use Stripe to register on your behalf' (docs-7, docs-14, docs-17, docs-18), but there is no evidence of per-registration pricing transparency or a status-tracking UI for registrations, and community commentary explicitly notes that beyond calculation you still have to handle much of the compliance work yourself. missing for 10: documented per-registration pricing, registration status tracking UI/API detail, independent confirmation the on-behalf registration service is fully automated rather than a manual/assisted add-on.
